stories.h: Westbound SR 520 closes tonight, Montlake to I-5
stories.s: WSDOT fully closes westbound SR 520 between Montlake Boulevard and I-5 from 10 p.m. Friday until 5 a.m. Monday for Portage Bay construction. Plan detours via I-90.

stories.h: Rain, wind return; coastal flood advisory for Puget Sound
stories.s: A frontal system brings rain and breezy winds Friday, with a coastal flood advisory for parts of inland Puget Sound from high tides. Stronger atmospheric-river storms follow through the weekend.

stories.h: Council sustains Mayor Wilson's veto of RV permit rule
stories.s: Seattle's council voted 5-3 to uphold Wilson's first veto, killing a requirement that people living in RVs get permits or face towing. Rob Saka switched sides, citing a new mayoral executive order.

stories.h: Sound Transit cages I-90 wires blamed for fish deaths
stories.s: Divers installed 13 mesh cages around anode strings on the I-90 floating bridge, suspected of electrocuting salmon near the 2 Line crossing. If they work, all 136 will be covered.

stories.h: Free Seattle/King County Clinic to end after 2027
stories.s: The volunteer-run pop-up clinic at Seattle Center, which has served over 36,000 patients since 2014, will hold its final event April 29 to May 2, 2027, citing rising costs and fading donations.

stories.h: Prosecutors launch public felony court-appearance dashboard
stories.s: The King County Prosecuting Attorney's Office released a searchable dashboard listing upcoming felony first appearances, charges, arresting agencies and bail amounts. Judges' names are omitted due to threats.

coming.h: 2 Line trains replaced by buses across Lake Washington
coming.s: All day Saturday and Sunday, shuttle buses every 10 minutes replace 2 Line trains between International District/Chinatown and South Bellevue for Mercer Island tunnel power work.

coming.h: Stronger storm Saturday night into Sunday
coming.s: A stronger system brings heavy rain and gusty winds Saturday night into Sunday. Major river flooding is not expected, but saturated soils raise landslide risk and leaves may clog drains.
